catalogRecords.name: DSH Cerrda Theme
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A dark rose and purple visual theme for DSH Web with a custom composer and animated background.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 为 DSH Web 提供暗色玫紫视觉主题、自定义输入区与动态背景。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source is 0.1.0 while npm exposes 0.1.1 from the same repository; no CSS, fonts, animation, or WebGL behavior was loaded.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码为 0.1.0，同仓库 npm 已发布 0.1.1；未加载 CSS、字体、动画或 WebGL 行为。

catalogRecords.name: DSH File
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A VS Code-style browser, editor, and markdown viewer for files in the current DSH workspace.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 为当前 DSH 工作区提供 VS Code 风格的文件浏览、编辑与 Markdown 查看。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source is 0.1.0 while npm exposes 0.0.1 without repository metadata; file reads, edits, markdown rendering, and browser loading were not executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码为 0.1.0，而 npm 为 0.0.1 且缺少仓库元数据；未执行文件读写、Markdown 渲染或浏览器加载。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Memory
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A persistent cross-session memory bundle with storage, tools, extraction, review, and context injection.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 集成存储、工具、抽取、复核与上下文注入的跨会话持久记忆组合包。
catalogRecords.noteEn: GitHub installation requires an explicitly allowed prepare build and mixed rc.5 peer declarations; no build, storage, extraction, or context injection was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: GitHub 安装需要显式放行 prepare 构建，Peer 声明混用 rc.5；未执行构建、存储、抽取或上下文注入。

catalogRecords.name: DSH DeepSeek Balance
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Displays DeepSeek account balance and editable warning thresholds in the DSH Web sidebar.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 在 DSH Web 侧栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额及可编辑的预警阈值。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source is 0.3.2 while npm exposes 0.3.1 from the same repository; balance requests and profile setting writes were not executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码为 0.3.2，同仓库 npm 为 0.3.1；未执行余额请求或 Profile 设置写入。

catalogRecords.name: DSH DeepCompute
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A terminal-styled idle laboratory game embedded as a full-width DSH Web page.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 嵌入 DSH Web 全宽页面的终端风 AI 实验室挂机游戏。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The repository documents a commit-pinnable GitHub install; no client module, game state, or browser storage behavior was loaded.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 仓库记录了可固定提交的 GitHub 安装方式；未加载客户端模块、游戏状态或浏览器存储行为。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Self Memory
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A file-backed memory plugin with weighted keyword recall, generalized problems, and contradiction-aware solutions.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 提供加权关键词召回、问题泛化与矛盾方案区分的文件型记忆插件。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source documents local-directory installation and stores generalized problem history on disk; no memory import, retrieval, or write was performed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码记录了本地目录安装，并在磁盘保存泛化问题历史；未执行记忆导入、检索或写入。

catalogRecords.name: DSH WHU Plugin
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Connects Wuhan University library, timetable, grades, exams, and weather services through tools and a local UI.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过工具与本地界面接入武汉大学图书馆、课表、成绩、考试和天气服务。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because no repository license file was found and the Python campus-service bridge handles login and academic data; no subprocess, login, or service request was started.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：未发现仓库许可证文件，且 Python 校园服务桥接涉及登录和教务数据；未启动子进程、登录或服务请求。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Desktop Plugin Installer
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds desktop settings controls for installing, enabling, disabling, removing, and restarting DSH plugins.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 在桌面设置中提供插件安装、启停、卸载与重启控制。
catalogRecords.noteEn: GitHub installation is documented; its command execution, profile mutation, uninstall, and desktop restart surfaces were reviewed statically and not invoked.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 已记录 GitHub 安装方式；仅静态核对命令执行、Profile 修改、卸载与桌面重启接口，均未调用。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Cloud Sync
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Synchronizes portable DSH profiles and local plugin sources through WebDAV or object storage.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过 WebDAV 或对象存储同步可迁移的 DSH Profile 与本地插件源码。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source is 0.20.0 while npm exposes 0.20.5 without repository metadata; no profile upload, download, credential use, or release check was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码为 0.20.0，而 npm 为 0.20.5 且缺少仓库元数据；未执行 Profile 上传下载、凭据使用或版本检查。

catalogRecords.name: Edtechools DSH Plugins
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A two-plugin workspace providing conversation turn navigation and credential-backed Bocha web search.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 包含会话轮次导航与基于凭据的博查搜索两个插件的工作区。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because the repository has no license file, both packages are unpublished, wildcard peers do not establish compatibility, and Git installation requires an allowed prepare build.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：仓库无许可证文件、两个包均未发布、通配 Peer 无法证明兼容性，且 Git 安装需要放行 prepare 构建。

catalogRecords.name: DSH AgentMemory
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Bridges DSH memory tools, activity capture, and context injection to a local AgentMemory REST server.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 把 DSH 记忆工具、活动捕获与上下文注入连接到本地 AgentMemory REST 服务。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The plugin requires a separately running local AgentMemory service and exposes a broad HTTP escape tool; no service call, capture hook, or prompt injection was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 插件依赖单独运行的本地 AgentMemory 服务，并提供较宽的 HTTP 逃生工具；未执行服务调用、捕获钩子或提示注入。

catalogRecords.name: DeepSeek Harness Wallet
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A local-first account, usage, recharge, completion, layout, and session control center for DSH Web.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 面向 DSH Web 的本地优先账户、用量、充值、完成提醒、布局与会话控制中心。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source and npm identity both expose 0.1.4 from the same repository; no credential request, accounting, recharge link, notification, or session action was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码与同仓库 npm 身份均为 0.1.4；未执行凭据请求、用量记账、充值链接、通知或会话操作。

catalogRecords.name: LinkHealth Intake Triage
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A healthcare business-intake workflow with role prompts, scoring, routing, and a deterministic PHI review guardrail.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 面向医疗业务咨询的角色提示、评分、路由与确定性 PHI 人审门禁工作流。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The canonical nested source includes a PHI-to-human-review invariant and writes a local triage log; no health data, role prompt, guardrail, or log write was processed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 规范嵌套源码包含 PHI 转人工复核约束并写入本地分诊日志；未处理医疗数据、角色提示、门禁或日志写入。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Cross Collaboration
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Discovers DSH peers over LAN or relay and delegates agent tasks to remote devices.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过局域网或中继发现 DSH 设备并委派远程 Agent 任务。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because the private package and repository declare no license, while the plugin exposes LAN discovery and remote delegated execution; no socket, relay, or task was started.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：私有包与仓库均未声明许可证，且插件暴露局域网发现与远程任务委派；未启动套接字、中继或任务。

catalogRecords.name: GEML DSH Plugin
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds addressable document blocks to DSH through the GEML MCP server and bundled authoring skills.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过 GEML MCP 服务与随包写作 Skills 为 DSH 提供可寻址文档块。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed integration is 1.0.1 while npm exposes 1.0.0 from the same repository; no npx subprocess, MCP request, skill, or document edit was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定集成为 1.0.1，同仓库 npm 为 1.0.0；未执行 npx 子进程、MCP 请求、Skill 或文档编辑。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Timer Scheduler
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Lets an agent schedule a future wake-up and shows reminders in a DSH Web panel.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 允许 Agent 安排未来唤醒，并在 DSH Web 面板显示提醒。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The source documents local installation and a future npm release; no timer, wake-up, reminder API, or browser panel was started.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 源码记录了本地安装与未来 npm 发布计划；未启动计时器、唤醒、提醒 API 或浏览器面板。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Notion Manager
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Exposes Notion search, pages, databases, blocks, comments, and users as DSH agent tools.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 把 Notion 搜索、页面、数据库、区块、评论与用户能力暴露为 DSH Agent 工具。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source supports credential references and broad Notion read and write tools; no token, workspace request, or content mutation was performed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码支持凭据引用及广泛的 Notion 读写工具；未使用令牌、请求工作区或修改内容。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Whale Button
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A draggable always-on-top whale button that focuses or opens the DSH desktop window.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 可拖动且始终置顶的鲸鱼按钮，用于聚焦或打开 DSH 桌面窗口。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because the package is private and omits its package license while spawning a native window helper; the repository MIT license and GitHub install are present, but no helper was started.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：包标记为私有且缺少包许可证，并会启动原生窗口辅助程序；仓库有 MIT 许可证及 GitHub 安装说明，但未启动辅助程序。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Plugins 4U
catalogRecords.summaryEn: An aggregate plugin suite for vision input, wallpaper customization, WeChat bridging, and a settings catalog.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 聚合识图输入、壁纸定制、微信桥接与设置目录的插件套件。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because no repository license file was found and the unpublished suite combines credentialed vision, filesystem wallpaper changes, and a WeChat bridge; none was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：未发现仓库许可证文件，且未发布套件组合了凭据识图、文件系统壁纸修改与微信桥接；均未执行。

catalogRecords.name: DSH OMC TUI
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A keyboard-first terminal interface that composes DSH sessions, approvals, jobs, tools, skills, and model selection.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 以键盘优先的终端界面组合 DSH 会话、审批、任务、工具、Skills 与模型选择。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The patch replaces several base tool and prompt rows to compose the TUI; no terminal, profile override, session, approval, or tool was run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 补丁会替换多个基础工具与提示行以组合 TUI；未运行终端、Profile 覆盖、会话、审批或工具。

catalogRecords.name: DSH RPG Workstation
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds conversation XP, levels, achievements, streaks, and a floating RPG dashboard to DSH Web.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 为 DSH Web 增加会话经验、等级、成就、连续记录与悬浮 RPG 面板。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source matches npm 0.3.0; no build, session event, XP state, filesystem write, or dashboard rendering was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码与 npm 0.3.0 一致；未执行构建、会话事件、经验状态、文件写入或面板渲染。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Preset Switcher
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds a session-header control and local API for changing an active session's agent preset.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过会话头部控件与本地 API 修改活动会话的 Agent Preset。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because no repository license file or remote package identity was found and installation is documented only from an absolute local path; no session preset was changed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：未发现仓库许可证文件或远程包身份，且仅记录绝对本地路径安装；未修改任何会话 Preset。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Session Admin
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adds archive, restore, export, and permanent deletion controls for DSH sessions.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 为 DSH 会话增加归档、恢复、导出与永久删除控制。
catalogRecords.noteEn: GitHub confirms dsh-session-manager redirects to the same repository ID now named dsh-session-admin; the fixed source is 0.1.2 while npm exposes 0.1.3, and no session mutation was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: GitHub 确认 dsh-session-manager 重定向到同一仓库 ID，现名 dsh-session-admin；固定源码为 0.1.2、npm 为 0.1.3，未修改会话。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Claude Code Plugins
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A large Claude Code parity workspace with permission rules, settings cascade, tools, hooks, MCP, memory, and profile bundles.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 包含权限规则、设置级联、工具、Hooks、MCP、记忆与 Profile Bundles 的大型 Claude Code 对齐工作区。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because the documented repository install targets a private root with no bundle, nested packages are unpublished, and workspace dependencies do not provide an external install identity; no hook or tool ran.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：文档中的仓库安装指向无 Bundle 的私有根包、嵌套包未发布，Workspace 依赖也未形成外部安装身份；未运行 Hook 或工具。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Memes

catalogRecords.summaryZh: 让 Agent 按语义标签选择反应图片并在 DSH 会话中呈现。

catalogRecords.noteZh: 插件代码为 MIT，但反应素材来自另一个库并受各自来源权利约束；未执行标签获取、选择或素材渲染。

catalogRecords.name: DSH LookatStudy
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Turns markdown, folders, or GitHub learning repositories into guided courses with mastery and spaced repetition.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 把 Markdown、文件夹或 GitHub 学习仓库转为带掌握度与间隔重复的引导课程。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source matches npm 0.9.0 and declares broad peer ranges; no repository import, course generation, learner state, tool, or dashboard was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码与 npm 0.9.0 一致，并声明较宽的 Peer 范围；未执行仓库导入、课程生成、学习状态、工具或面板。

catalogRecords.name: Clawock DSH
catalogRecords.summaryEn: An investment-decision workflow with evidence, an opposing case, deterministic settlement, and a scorecard tab.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 包含证据、反方论证、确定性结算与记分卡页面的投资决策工作流。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The nested integration is a real published package, not a fixture; the fixed source is 0.1.6 while npm exposes 0.1.8, and no market fetch, decision, or settlement ran.

catalogRecords.name: DSH Lan Memory
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A memory and persona system with pinned facts, JSONL retrieval, experience, soul, mood, settings, and sidebar cards.

catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because no repository license file or remote package identity was found and only local-directory installation is documented; no memory, persona, or mood state was written.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：未发现仓库许可证文件或远程包身份，且仅记录本地目录安装；未写入记忆、人格或情绪状态。

catalogRecords.name: DSH QQ Bot
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Connects DSH agents to QQ through OneBot WebSocket or the official QQ bot platform.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 通过 OneBot WebSocket 或 QQ 官方机器人平台把 DSH Agent 接入 QQ。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because npm exposes 1.0.1 without repository metadata while the fixed source is 0.2.0 and documents only local installation; no bot login, message, or agent session was started.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：npm 发布 1.0.1 但无仓库元数据，固定源码为 0.2.0 且仅记录本地安装；未启动机器人登录、消息或 Agent 会话。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Client UI Android

catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source documents npm and GitHub installation but npm has no matching package; no user-agent detection, layout mutation, or browser rendering was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码记录了 npm 与 GitHub 安装，但 npm 无匹配包；未执行 UA 检测、布局修改或浏览器渲染。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Freebuff
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Adapts the unofficial Freebuff desktop protocol into a DSH model provider.

catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because it reimplements an undocumented third-party desktop protocol and free service without confirmed API authorization; no request, identity, or model response was sent.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 暂缓：其重实现未公开的第三方桌面协议与免费服务，尚无明确 API 授权；未发送请求、身份或模型响应。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Firefly Theme
catalogRecords.summaryEn: A Firefly character theme with wallpapers, GIFs, music, neon styling, and a startup transformation animation.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 包含流萤角色壁纸、GIF、音乐、霓虹样式与开屏变身动画的主题。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held because the MIT license covers code while the repository redistributes HoYoverse character art, GIFs, and music whose copyright remains with third parties; no media was loaded.

catalogRecords.name: Catalog Capabilities ZH

catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source delegates installation to environment-provided plugin or skill managers and includes a Python catalog script; no inspection, subprocess, or install was run.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码把安装委派给环境已有的插件或 Skill 管理器，并包含 Python 目录脚本；未运行检查、子进程或安装。

catalogRecords.name: DSH Agency Agents

catalogRecords.summaryZh: 带远程与 DSH Web 集成界面的可召唤领域专家角色库。
catalogRecords.noteEn: The fixed source is 0.1.17 while npm exposes 0.1.19 from the same repository; no build, expert invocation, remote request, subagent, or UI was executed.
catalogRecords.noteZh: 固定源码为 0.1.17，同仓库 npm 为 0.1.19；未执行构建、专家调用、远程请求、Subagent 或界面。
